title: A unified approach to nonlinear Stein theorems
summary: We study regularity for the variable exponent quasilinear $\mathfrak{p}\left(x\right)$-Laplace type equation on domains in Heisenberg groups and Euclidean spaces. We establish borderline continuity estimates for the appropriate first order derivatives of solutions.
